description:
Design, develop, and optimize large-scale data pipelines (Batch & Streaming).
Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes, Data Lakes, and Data Warehouses.
Design robust data models to support analytics, reporting, and business intelligence.
Ensure data quality, reliability, security, and governance across the platform.
Optimize data processing performance and query efficiency.
Collaborate closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver impactful data solutions.
Mentor team members, conduct technical reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices.
requirements_text:
5 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
Hands-on experience building and managing ETL/ELT pipelines.
Expertise in at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience with Data Warehouse technologies such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Synapse.
Familiarity with Spark, Kafka, or Databricks.
Experience with Airflow or other workflow orchestration tools.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently.
Nice to have
Experience implementing Data Platforms or Data Lakehouse architectures.
Exposure to AI/ML projects, MLOps, or DataOps practices.
Cloud or Data-related certifications.
